target: Only missed visible abrasion in low-resolution input.
change: Only changed factor versus cue-1: bounded linear exposure normalization on the optional input (mean luminance 12..<80, gain min(1.8,110/mean)). Same 1024-token rendering floor, prompt/schema/deadline and gates. One optional abrasion-only call on enlarged input after an empty low-resolution baseline. Existing findings, category/material/identity remain untouched. Recovered clue is possible, mechanism unclear. No model weights or live app changes.

gate.requiredRepairs: First-user small320 miss plus at least one other previously missed damaged variant; subsequent independent-repeat check must retain the repair.
gate.preservePositive: Every baseline nonempty finding list, clarity, category, material and mechanism must remain unchanged.
gate.falseAlarm: No new finding on a visually negative control, including fresh-source controls.
gate.authority: No rescued finding becomes clear or claims a sliding mechanism; no category/material/identity change.
gate.latency: One extra request maximum per empty low-resolution photo. 2500ms transport deadline, baseline preserved on error. Observed p95 overhead <=2600ms including rendering.

boundary: Original primary/verifier observations are the preserved actual run. Only the optional new call is executed in this run. Compare semantics on the same baseline; latency is original stage time plus measured addedMs. Still an exposed development set, not general accuracy.
